architecture.actual_construction: ClassificationModel -> CrossAxisSummaryTransformer ->12 CrossAxisSummaryLayer modules; no inactive alternative architecture flag.

architecture.ssmax: TensorAttention scales Q using learned/persistent head_scale; projected K is multiplied by log(full context length); score_scale=None retains SDPA default1/sqrt(head_width). Query cross-attention reuses and expands the first context head; preserve this exactly.

loading.why_not_unqualified_from_pretrained: Preset revision is main and checkpoint_sha256=None. from_pretrained(weights=local) explicitly disables digest verification even when a manifest exists; low-level pinned loader avoids that bypass.

Safetensors reader on CPU; never pickle checkpoint or trust remote model code.

Official loader copies into every expected state tensor and clears caches; no dropped/renamed keys, no partial load, no remapping to another backbone.
After load record actual module types/counts, parameter/buffer totals, summary token shapes, class head10, checkpoint/state checksums and compute dtypes.

fixed_model_recipe.model_manifest: Released classifier architecture, class_capacity10; frozen release preset defaults except explicit execution adaptation and pinned provenance.
fixed_model_recipe.parameter_dtype: float16 after official loading of FP32 checkpoint
fixed_model_recipe.preprocessing_compute: Official NumPy/CPU float64 fitting and transforms; outputs member features float32.
fixed_model_recipe.aggregation: Original class-permutation inversion, mean member logits then softmax; not probability averaging.
fixed_model_recipe.full_support: 8693<100000, so every support row retained. Assert actual stored and every forwarded support count; never reduce limit or sample for memory.
fixed_model_recipe.categorical_mask: Explicit NumPy bool mask in the fixed13-column order; no accidental numerical-column inference.

fixed_model_recipe.recipe_disclosure: CPU-generated official ensemble random draws are fixed and shared by CPU/MPS tests. This is not claimed bitwise equivalent to CUDA RNG for the same integer seed; it preserves the released CPU recipe and default8 view construction.

portability_findings.finding: The estimator accepts torch.device, but max_vram_bytes is explicitly CUDA-only. Non-CUDA forward avoids cuda_budget and currently batches every ensemble member at once; that default is unsuitable as a memory guarantee on16GB M4.

Official non-CUDA _select_sdpa_backend returns FLASH_ATTENTION, including CPU/MPS. The local adapter removes that forced context and uses pinned PyTorch native/default device SDPA. Actual MPS kernel choice is not asserted; full numerical and memory gates remain required.

FeatureEnsemble constructs generator/device float64 sign tensors and device permutation state. Keep the entire official preprocessing and RNG onCPU; transformed member matrices are alreadyFP32. Leave aggregation plan and logits onCPU to satisfy official same-device checks.
CAST still forms item-axis self-attention over32summary+all support rows for each feature group.20.8M weights do not remove quadratic support attention or prove memory feasibility.

At pinned code the CUDA planner DOES expose query/support cache branches, despite README wording saying the default wrapper does not use them. Non-CUDA default plan does not select those branches. Cache availability is not a reason to silently change our first probe.

fixed_local_execution.adapter_scope: Local EXAONE-named wrapper/subclass or confined vendor patch only; keep original immutable source snapshot and explicit diff/hash. Do not globally monkeypatch torch SDPA or change weights/model topology.
fixed_local_execution.sdpa_backend: Pinned PyTorch native/default device SDPA dispatch for CPU and MPS, with the fixed shape-only Q/batch schedule; no forced CUDA FLASH context and no assertion of a specific internal MPS kernel.
fixed_local_execution.sdpa_boundary: Split already projected/scaled flat_query along independent flat-batch and Q dimensions; every block uses the matching entire flat_key/flat_value sequences. Concatenate attended outputs before the unchanged output projection.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not call whole attention.forward(query_slice, context=None): that changes self-attention K/V and SSMax length.
Do not truncate or split K/V into independently normalized softmaxes.
Do not change head count, first-head reuse/expansion, head_scale, score_scale, summary tokens, residuals, normalization, NaN path or dtype.
Do not replace logit aggregation with probability mean.
Do not reduce support/views or enable cross-query cache after seeing speed/memory/results.
fixed_local_execution.transactional_cache: Existing per-attention context-projection cache semantics still apply even when cross-query support caching is disabled. Cache only after the entire forward succeeds; preserve complete K/V and first-head selection.
fixed_local_execution.root_acceptance: Root accepted the K256 boundary/batch1-or512/Q256 shape-only execution strategy before any probe or score, avoiding millions of one-row short-attention MPS launches.

mathematical_checks.query_independence: Item-axis context is summary+support only; query rows read it without entering it. Feature operations are row-local. Released columns_per_group=1 avoids general multi-coordinate packing dependence; nevertheless test constant/missing/unseen-category cases and partition equality rather than assuming every generalized model is independent.
mathematical_checks.support_cache: Official can_cache_support and can_cache_query_chunks guard feature-retention compatibility. First fixed probe disables cross-query support caching; this changes resource execution, not intended outputs, subject to the CPU/MPS equivalence gates.
kernel_cases: Self-attention, cross-attention, multiple heads6, first-context-head reuse, cache write/read and no-cache paths.
K=256 and257 boundary with non-divisible Q=513; multi-flat-batch crossing512 onshortK, multiplebatch onlongK.
Compare against unmodified projected-Q/K/V SDPA output at the same FP16 compute dtype; preserve SSMax log(fullK), learned head scale and default score scale.
Inject an error in a later chunk and verify no partially committed cache; no GPU needed for this boundary test.
mathematical_checks.kernel_case_cost_note: Exercise the batch512 andQ256 boundaries in separate small cases, not a513batch-by513query combined stress case.

memory_analysis.assumption: Illustrative13retainedfeatures plus labelgroup =14,6heads,one member. Actual intermediate peaks and allocator workspace must be measured; math backend may accumulate inFP32 even withFP16 weights.
memory_analysis.limitation: These are attention-score tensor sizes, not total model peak. Full K/V projections, state tensors, FFN, residuals, CPU member storage and backend workspace remain. Serial8 and bounded Q chunks improve plausibility, not a fit guarantee.

resource_probe.fixtures: Fixed synthetic seed20261117, numeric/categorical13columns, balanced binary support labels, explicit mask, NaNs and unseen query categories. Save fixture IDs/hashes and no real development/test data in this probe.

All8, full support, query1024 internal split with remainder; record per-forward support rows, selected chunk policy, elapsed time and memory snapshots.
All8, full support, samefixed execution. No view1/full8 extrapolation.
All4277 predictions, save CPU portable artifact, destroy device engines, reload reconstruct and infer all4277 again. Compare every ID/probability and threshold decision.

resource_probe.failure: Any missing checkpoint key, backend/dtype failure, math mismatch, threshold disagreement, OOM, incompleteview/context, or2400s expiry is failed/incomplete. Keep evidence; do not widen tolerance, reduce support/views, increase budget, swap precision, enablecache or silentlyfall back.

resource_probe.success: Only establishes this exact full8 CPU/MPS numerical/resource/portable path. No real score, no S-tier, no competition upload and no claim of top5 improvement.
